name: GBE1 (GBED)
summary: GBE1 (GBED), glycogen branching enzyme deficiency - a recessive lethal at birth. The foal cannot store or release sugar.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: GBE1 (GBED) carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy of gbed. The horse is completely normal and there is no way to see it - but half its foals inherit the copy, and two carriers bred together are the only way glycogen branching enzyme deficiency appears.

phenotypes.name: Glycogen branching enzyme deficiency
phenotypes.description: The foal cannot store or release sugar. It is weak from birth, cannot keep itself warm, and has nothing to draw on.
